description: This file defines the MemorySessionStorage class implementing session storage using in-memory storage in the OrangeHRM HR management system. It interacts with Symfony components to manage session bags and metadata.

classes.name: MemorySessionStorage
classes.description: Implements session storage functionality using in-memory structures for the OrangeHRM system, managing session bags and metadata.

methods.name: start
methods.description: Starts the session, always returns true.

methods.name: isStarted
methods.description: Checks if the session is started, always returns true.

methods.name: getId
methods.description: Returns an empty session ID string.

methods.name: setId
methods.description: Sets the session ID (no-op in this implementation).

methods.name: setName
methods.description: Sets the session name (no-op in this implementation).

methods.name: regenerate
methods.description: Regenerates session ID, optionally destroys current session, and stamps new metadata if destroyed.

methods.name: save
methods.description: Saves the session (no-op in this implementation).

methods.name: getBag
methods.description: Retrieves a session bag by name, throws exception if not registered.

methods.name: getMetadataBag
methods.description: Returns the metadata bag associated with the session storage.
